fieldNotes.truckGate: A guarded checkpoint at the SW corner (~41.6633,-88.1130): the truck driveway curves in from the access road and passes a guard booth with barrier-arm gates and a chainlink fence corner. Confirmed in 2022 Street View — controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white guard booth with windows on multiple sides, ~1-vehicle footprint, set beside the truck gate lanes. Clearly visible in Street View — distinct from the DC building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a staffed guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single inbound lane past the guard booth; single outbound. Entry and exit share the one gate complex → entryExitTogether.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Standard single-lane-each-way guarded gate; no notable spare paved width for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The truck driveway curves in from the access road and opens into a deep truck court along the building's W face — holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors and trailers concentrated along the building's W (truck-court) face; no second separate dock cluster — ship and receive run from the one dock line.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock line with dock doors and trailers backed in along the ~600m W face — into the 50+ band. dockDoorCount ~90 is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Rows of detached trailers in the fenced W truck court — estimated 25-50 band; dropYard true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Romeoville IL, in the I-55 / Joliet-area logistics corridor — a dense cluster of large distribution buildings. Urban industrial fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from the building footprint plus the W truck court / drop yard and the S office parking; building is one of the larger DCs in the corridor.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved truck court inside the gate before the dock doors provides holding room.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
